# Tokens

Every token of the system, a section per group: Surfaces — 2 tokens; Text — 1 token; Fills and status backgrounds — 3 tokens; Borders and rings — 2 tokens; Palette ramps and brand — 19 tokens; Type styles, families, font files; Spacing — 8 tokens; Radius — 5 tokens; Shadow — 2 tokens; Border width — 3 tokens.

## Color · Surfaces

### Use

```css
/* in a page’s CSS, in the light theme: the token’s name, with its value from the same row of the table below as the fallback, so the page draws whether or not it links tokens.css */
color: var(--background, #f6f7f5);
/* a page in another theme: link or inline tokens.css, put data-theme="dark" on the element that wraps the page, and take each fallback from the dark column; where tokens.css cannot be linked, the value alone, from that theme’s column */
color: var(--background, #0f1211);
/* on a slide, in a chart’s options, or anywhere else var() cannot go, and in an SVG attribute such as fill, which not every browser reads var() in: the value alone, from the column of the theme it is in */
color: #f6f7f5;
```

### Tokens (2)

| token | light | dark | usage |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `--background` | #f6f7f5 | #0f1211 | Page canvas behind panels. Maps to --background. |
| `--surface` | #ffffff | #181c1b | Panels, cards, inputs, assistant bubbles. Maps to --surface. |

## Type

Set text in one of the styles below: write its values from the Styles and Families tables, or, on a page that links or inlines tokens.css, prefer its variable, where the Styles table’s CSS column gives one.

### Use

```css
/* any surface: a style’s values from the Styles and Families tables */
font: 600 24px/32px "Geist", ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, "Segoe UI", Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif; letter-spacing: -0.01em;
/* a page that links or inlines tokens.css: prefer the variables, so that a change to tokens.css reaches the page */
font: var(--text-title-lg); letter-spacing: -0.01em;
font-family: var(--font-sans);   /* the family alone */
```

### Styles

| style | CSS | size / line, italic, letter spacing | weight | family | usage |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `title-lg` | `.title-lg`, `--text-title-lg` | 24px / 32px, letter-spacing -0.01em | 600 | `sans` | Screen titles (portal header, inspector run title). |
| `title` | `.title`, `--text-title` | 18px / 26px | 600 | `sans` | Panel titles. |
| `heading` | `.heading`, `--text-heading` | 15px / 22px | 600 | `sans` | Ticket titles, timeline event names, table group headers. |
| `body-lg` | `.body-lg`, `--text-body-lg` | 16px / 24px | 400 | `sans` | Tenant chat bubbles and tenant-facing notices. Never smaller than this for tenant messages. |
| `body` | `.body`, `--text-body` | 14px / 20px | 400 | `sans` | Default UI text, ticket descriptions, form labels. |
| `body-sm` | `.body-sm`, `--text-body-sm` | 13px / 18px | 400 | `sans` | Meta lines, hints, inspector table cells. |
| `label` | `.label`, `--text-label` | 12px / 16px, letter-spacing 0.01em | 500 | `sans` | Badges, column headers, pipeline stage labels. |
| `mono` | `.mono`, `--text-mono` | 13px / 20px | 400 | `mono` | JSON blocks, IDs, tool names. |
| `mono-sm` | `.mono-sm`, `--text-mono-sm` | 12px / 16px | 400 | `mono` | Numeric cells: tokens, duration, cost. Use tabular figures. |

### Families

| family | CSS variable | stack |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `sans` | `--font-sans` | `"Geist", ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, "Segoe UI", Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif` |
| `mono` | `--font-mono` | `"Geist Mono", ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Consolas, monospace` |

## Spacing

### Use

```css
/* any surface: a token’s value from the table below */
padding: 4px;
/* a page that links or inlines tokens.css: prefer the token’s name, so that a change to tokens.css reaches the page */
padding: var(--space-1);
```

### Tokens (8)

| token | value | usage |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `--space-1` | 4px | Icon-to-label gap, badge vertical padding. |
| `--space-2` | 8px | Badge horizontal padding, gaps in meta rows. |
| `--space-3` | 12px | Control padding (x), bubble padding (y), table cell padding. |
| `--space-4` | 16px | Card and bubble padding, gap between stacked fields. |
| `--space-5` | 20px | Panel padding on mobile. |
| `--space-6` | 24px | Panel padding on desktop, gap between panels. |
| `--space-8` | 32px | Section separation, empty-state padding. |
| `--space-12` | 48px | Page gutters on wide screens. |

### Use

```css

/* a page that links or inlines tokens.css: prefer var(--shadow-sm), so that a change to tokens.css, or a change of theme, reaches the page */
```

### Tokens (2)

| token | value | usage |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `--shadow-sm` | 0 1px 2px rgba(16,24,22,0.06) · dark: 0 1px 2px rgba(0,0,0,0.5) | Panels on background. The only resting shadow. |
| `--shadow-md` | 0 4px 16px rgba(16,24,22,0.10) · dark: 0 6px 20px rgba(0,0,0,0.55) | Floating layers only: select menus, toasts. |
